thread:
Noah (product): new iteration on the rollout timeline row — can we land final decisions on (1) inline snapshot CTA, (2) rollback confirmation UX, and (3) how SR should announce traffic changes? mock: https://figma.redwood/rollout-row-v3
Priya (design): TL;DR: keep snapshot inline but demote visually; rollback stays in overflow but with a compact inline danger indicator when selected. prefer 'Snapshot' label over 'Restore point' for clarity.
Ava (frontend): Agree with inline snapshot. For rollback: prefer lightweight inline confirm popover rather than full modal; then show undo toast for 12s. keyboard: focus must return to row after popover closed.
Diego (eng-runtime): backend will make rollback async. we'll return an op-id and progress pct. recommend showing 'Rolling back 60% done' in the row and an accessible label. also suggest: if op fails, show expanded error details in the row and link to operation log.
Rina (a11y): Announcements: use aria-live polite for status updates (held, snapshot created). For rollback initiation, call out: role=alertdialog focused with message 'Rollback to vX triggered. This will redirect live traffic; ETA ~90s.' also include a link to 'View operation details' with proper aria-describedby. example markup suggestions in thread.
Noah (product): copy options: Option X: primary small = 'Snapshot'; overflow = 'Rollback' (danger); inline CTA = 'Hold' Option Y: primary small = 'Hold' + 'Snapshot' combo; overflow = 'Rollback' Option Z: primary = 'Pause', secondary = 'Snapshot', inline rollback = visible danger.
Priya (design): leaning Option X. keeps actions separate and reduces accidental destructive clicks. small microcopy under row: 'Snapshot saved 6 restore available' (we'll tighten grammar).
Ava (frontend): for small screens collapse CTAs into a single kebab menu, but still show status pill and textual status. ensure accessible names for menu items.
Diego (eng-runtime): add op-id to toast: 'Rollback initiated (op-9912)'. also tag to support context: user id + team id.
Rina (a11y): Note: Ensure that undo toast is keyboard dismissible and announced with role=status. Also include a short SR-only summary when timeline updates outside focus.
Noah (product): quick reactions please: :+1: Option X, :heart: Option Y, :thinking_face: Option Z
Priya (design): :+1:
Ava (frontend): :+1:
Diego (eng-runtime): :heart:
Rina (a11y): :+1:
DeployBot: Snapshot snap-20240603-9912 created for v3.0-beta
Noah (product): next steps: Priya update wire and microcopy; Ava prototype popover and small-screen menus; Diego surface op-id + link in toasts; Rina finalize SR copy. I'll schedule handoff review on Thursday. Thanks everyone.
